language_note: Whether each of Peleliu's usual residents speaks Palauan, 2020 census (Table 16): 'Palauan' is the 220 who speak Palauan only and the 183 who speak it and another language; 'Other languages' the 67 who speak another language and not Palauan. The table's lines on which other language is spoken add up to the number who speak Palauan, not to those who do not, so which languages the rest speak is not known here.
median_age_note: Median age of Peleliu's usual residents as Table 6 of the 2020 census prints it. The volume's summary Table 1 prints lower medians (36.3 for the country, against Table 6's 37.9) that Table 6's age groups do not give.
